dedupe_keys.name: building footprints in phnom penh open development cambodia

description: Open Development Cambodia (ODC) publishes the outlines of buildings in Phnom Penh, clipped to the city boundary from an open satellite-derived building footprint dataset (the page describes it as derived from high-resolution imagery and produced by a project based in Ghana), with English and Khmer versions, a WMS layer and a preview map. Coverage: Phnom Penh; the portal record was last modified on 2023-10-18. Format and access: GeoPackage (shapefile, KML, GeoJSON exports), SQLite, WMS, PNG, downloadable without registration from the Open Development Cambodia data hub (OD Mekong Datahub); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike; cost: free. Caveats: the footprints are model-derived from imagery, not survey data, and the page gives no building count or accuracy figure for Phnom Penh; the files were not opened; the portal states a Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike licence while the upstream footprint dataset carries its own terms. Simulation uses: exposure layers for flood and heat models, population and housing allocation, and urban growth analysis where no cadastral building layer is public. Related catalogue records: 3D-GloBFP: global three-dimensional building footprints with estimated heights (2020) (data-3d-globfp-global-3d-building-footprints); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
